strategy.offer: Care, housing, therapy, work and counseling services for older people, people with disabilities, and people with mental illness, plus vocational training and applied research.
strategy.customers: Older adults, people with disabilities, people with psychological or psychosomatic conditions, their families, and professionals and managers in health and social services.
strategy.why_we_win: It argues that linking frontline practice with science, lifelong learning, and individualized treatment creates better care quality and more effective services.
strategy.resources: Its basis is a broad service network, specialized clinical and care staff, a certified education provider, and research teams working with external academic partners.
strategy.direction: It is heading toward closer integration of care, education, and interdisciplinary research to develop and evaluate new service models.

strategy.offer: Provides eldercare, disability housing and support, mental health and psychosomatic treatment, training, research, and related practical services.
strategy.customers: Serves older adults, people with disabilities or mental illness, families and caregivers, learners, and institutional clients needing support or operational services.
strategy.why_we_win: Expects success through person-centered, needs-based support, active client participation, and flexible concepts spanning outpatient, residential, therapeutic, educational, and everyday-life assistance.
strategy.resources: Built on multidisciplinary professional teams, specialist medical and care expertise, practical therapy and production know-how, and a broad network of facilities.

evidence.quote: In der ersten Etage stehen auf der zweiten Fliedner-Fläche rund 2.400m² für die Fliedner Werkstätten bereit.
Im zweiten Geschoss wurde auf einer Fläche von ca. 1.650 m² ein moderner Standort für die generalistische Pflegeausbildung erschaffen.
95 Menschen mit Behinderungen durchlaufen in der Betriebsstätte Parkstadt unter anderem eine rund zwei Jahre dauernde Berufsbildungsmaßnahme
Die Zusammenarbeit hat nicht nur zu einer Erweiterung der Art der Versendungen geführt, von einfachen Paketen hin zu individuellen und hochwertigen Produktsendungen
Unser neues Freizeitangebot im Grünen heißt „Theos Gärtchen“.
